'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Reid Smith DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Reid Smith]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name on sheet: IG. Transcription note: name on sheet "R Smith" only - small-world rule: Reid Smith (LS on p104)
